artifacts.summary: Five-phase plan (4 waves, 5 hours) replacing the /refresh matcher with a single atomic ps -eo snapshot plus four named exclusion predicates, adding the mandatory regression suite and its manifest registration, making both timer ExecStart sites non-destructive, reconciling the remaining doc sites, and sweeping all seven acceptance criteria read-only.
Orchestrator handoff recording status planned, 0/5 phases, and the six plan-time decisions downstream dispatches must not re-litigate.

memory_candidates.content: When a safety-critical selector (process killer, file deleter, mail mutator) is wired to an unattended timer with a --force-equivalent flag, treat the timer's default action and the selector's correctness as two independent defects requiring two independent fixes. Fixing only the selector leaves a latent amplifier: the next selector bug becomes an unattended hourly destructive action. The durable posture is that the automated cadence REPORTS and the destructive mode is an explicit opt-in, applied at BOTH the shipped unit file and the installer that generates an equivalent unit -- otherwise a fresh install and an existing deployment diverge in posture. Additionally, a safety predicate must never degrade silently when its input data source is unavailable (e.g. a ps cgroup column missing on another platform); it must fail loudly and non-zero, because a permissive fallback reintroduces exactly the defect being fixed.
